description.id: Gambaran umum salat jenazah berjemaah. Bacaan, posisi, dan rincian tertentu dapat berbeda menurut mazhab dan kondisi jenazah.
description.en: A general overview of the funeral prayer in congregation. Recitations, positions, and some details may differ by school and circumstance.

description.id: Penuhi syarat salat dan ikuti arahan imam atau pengurus masjid.
description.en: Meet the prayer's conditions and follow the imam's or mosque's instructions.

translation.id: Berwudu, menghadap kiblat, dan berdiri bila mampu. Jenazah diletakkan di hadapan jamaah sesuai pengaturan setempat. Salat jenazah dilakukan berdiri dan tidak memiliki rukuk maupun sujud.
translation.en: Perform wudu, face the qibla, and stand if able. The deceased is placed before the congregation according to local arrangements. The funeral prayer is performed standing and has no bowing or prostration.

sources.reference: Sahih Muslim, Book of Funerals (prayer over the deceased)

description.id: Ikuti takbir imam dan bacaan yang diajarkan dalam tradisi setempat.
description.en: Follow the imam's takbirs and the recitations taught in the local tradition.

translation.id: Salat jenazah umumnya terdiri dari empat takbir. Setelah takbir, jamaah membaca bacaan salat dan doa untuk jenazah sesuai urutan yang diajarkan imam. Rincian bacaan setelah tiap takbir dapat berbeda, jadi ikuti imam dan panduan mazhab.
translation.en: The funeral prayer commonly consists of four takbirs. After the takbirs, the congregation recites prayer passages and supplications for the deceased according to the imam's sequence. The specific recitations after each takbir can differ, so follow the imam and school guidance.

title.en: Supplicate for the deceased and conclude

description.id: Mohonkan ampun dan rahmat bagi jenazah, lalu akhiri salat mengikuti imam.
description.en: Ask forgiveness and mercy for the deceased, then conclude the prayer with the imam.

translation.id: Doakan kebaikan bagi jenazah dan keluarga yang ditinggalkan. Akhiri dengan salam sesuai tuntunan imam. Setelah salat, ikuti arahan keluarga dan pengurus mengenai pengantaran jenazah serta jaga kehormatan keluarga.
translation.en: Supplicate for the deceased and the bereaved family. Conclude with the salutation according to the imam's guidance. Afterward, follow the family's and organizers' directions for the funeral procession and respect the family.
